outcome: exclusive breastfeeding for the first two days (EBF2D)
cohort: A national sample of 9,242 Infant and Young Children (IYC) below 24 months of age, selected from birth registry data across Saudi Arabia's five regions.
finding: Lower odds of meeting breastfeeding indicators were observed among IYC of Saudi nationality, first-borns, or those born prematurely or by Cesarean section, while maternal employment/student status was associated with higher odds of mixed milk feeding.
mod_finding: Infant and Young Children (IYC) born by Cesarean section had lower odds of meeting the defined breastfeeding indicators.
